name: Prairie Lake Recreation Area
note: Little Blue NRD recreation area on a 36-acre flood-control lake on Thirty-Two Mile Creek (trolling motors only, no boat launch), south of Prairie Lake Rd 3 mi S and 1 mi E of Juniata. The 20 concrete back-in pads (built 2021) form a herringbone on the grassy rise north of the lake, beside a shelter, concrete restroom and playground; power and water are off Dec 1 - Apr 1, and the archery range is closed to camping. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Little Blue NRD recreation page (littlebluenrd.org/recreation/, read 2026-11-05): '20 RV camper pads with electrical hookups ($20 per night fee; effective April 1, 2022), shelter, restroom ... well water' + Prairie Lake Site Specific Rules (updated July 2026) 06.01A 'Camping ... permitted in the areas designated' (map marks 'Electrical Hookups' at the pad array) + Hastings Tribune via Modern Campground 2022-04-04: 'opened ... 20 concrete RV pads with electrical hook-ups ... 30-50 amps', FCFS, honor boxes, no showers or dump + Esri Wayback 2021-10-19 and World Imagery 2025-03-12: herringbone of ~20 paved back-in spurs ~20-23 m long off a gravel lane from Prairie Lake Rd (a plain grass field in the 2020-06-10 capture) + The Dyrt review 2025-10-24 ('smaller but is very clean') -> real NRD drive-in RV campground. Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri Wayback 2021-10-19 (WV03 0.31 m, z18 + z19, rendered, leaf-on) and World Imagery 2025-03-12 (Vantor 0.34 m export, rendered) at 40.53661,-98.48951: the pad array sits on open grass, its east tips ~90-95 m from the lake's east cove (water edge ~40.5366,-98.4881), with a dirt track (trail/primitive-camping access) and a ~20 m strip of tall grass/reed with scattered shrubs between - a used track and the distance rule cap it at a view, no on-water value. View confirmed by USGS 3DEP profile along 40.5366: 591.2 m at the pads, 587.8, 585.4, 583.9, 582.5 m at the shore, 581.6 m water - one open slope falling ~9.6 m to the water, so the low shore shrubs cannot screen it (floor rule: open ground with the water unscreened -> at least lakeview). South and west sides are screened (tree clump; park road + trees). Lake 36 acres (NRD; 65 incl. adjoining water per the 2022 Tribune), a lake not a pond. Dam check: the earthen dam is the straight N-S embankment on the lake's east side (~-98.4843, 430 m E of the pads); the pads are upstream on the lake side and ~9.6 m above pool, not below the dam.

fees.note: $20 a night for an electric camper pad (effective April 1, 2022), paid at honor boxes; NRD rule: pay within 30 minutes of set-up, permits expire 6 pm the next day. No annual park permit required.

fees_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/recreation/#Prairie_Lake, read 2026-11-05: '20 RV camper pads with electrical hookups ($20 per night fee; effective April 1, 2022)' (Prairie Lake is not on the 2021 fee schedule PDF, whose payment rules - 'payable within 30 minutes of set-up', 'expire at 6:00 PM the day following purchase', 'No Annual Park Permits are Required' - are district-wide); Modern Campground 2022-04-04 (Hastings Tribune): '$20 for the night, payable through honor boxes'. Every RV site is the electric class, so only that class is priced (shape copied from 15614 Liberty Cove).
booking_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/wp-content/uploads/Final-07_14_2026-Park-Rules-Regulations.pdf, read 2026-11-05: '01.05C Campsites are provided on a first-come, first-served basis.'; '01.05I Camping is permitted for a maximum of fourteen (14) consecutive days on any single area during any thirty (30) - day period.'; Modern Campground 2022-04-04: 'open on a no-reservation first-come, first-served basis'
flags: Duplicate check: no entry named Prairie Lake / Juniata in Nebraska; nearest DB campgrounds are 2765 Adams County Fairgrounds (8 km) and 2688 Crystal Lake Ayr (11 km). Not on RV Life (Algolia bbox 40.50-40.58, -98.55 - -98.43 empty; the name query finds only MN/OR/TX/WA/AB parks).

Location conflict settled on imagery: the only pads are the herringbone at 40.53661,-98.48951 (in Sec 31's NW quarter), reached by a gravel lane off Prairie Lake Rd at ~40.5391,-98.4906 - ~3.5 mi S and ~0.8 mi E of Juniata (Open-Meteo geocode 40.59001,-98.50618). That fits the July 2026 Site Specific Rules ('three (3) miles south and one (1) mile east') over the NRD page ('3 miles south and 1/4 mile east') and the 2022 Tribune ('a half-mile east'). The NRD's campground map (SSR Appendix V) places 'Electrical Hookups' at the same herringbone. Pads were built 2021: a grass field in the 2020-06-10 capture, paved in 2021-10-19.

Waterfront lakeview rests on imagery + the 3DEP slope (no per-site map or site photo). The used dirt track between the pads and the cove rules out lakefront; a dated photo from a pad would confirm the view. Unlike Liberty Cove (screened, not waterfront), the ground here falls openly to the water.
Lake size disagrees: NRD '36 acres of water and access for 29 additional water acres'; Tribune '65-acre body of water'. Note uses 36 (NRD).

Structured data for stamping: hookups.electric 50 (Modern Campground/Hastings Tribune 2022-04-04: '20 RV pads that contain 30-50 amps of electrical capacity'); water/sewer at site not stated by the NRD (The Dyrt says 'electric and water hookups' - aggregator, leave absent); sites.count 20 (NRD page '20 RV camper pads with electrical hookups', '20 electrical camper pads', read 2026-11-05); max_rig_ft 40 (General Regulations 01.05K, approved 07/14/2026: 'Camper units may not exceed 102" in width and forty (40) feet in length'); pads concrete back-ins ~20-23 m on imagery, no pull-throughs seen; booking reservable false, fcfs always, max_stay_nights 14 (General Regulations 01.05C/01.05I); facilities: showers false + dump false (Tribune 2022: 'concrete restroom building nearby but does not provide showers or a dump station'), potable_water true ('well water', NRD page), restroom (type not stated), shelter, playground, grills, archery range; season not stated - nrdnet.org/node/589 (Nebraska NRDs site) says 'Power and water services are suspended December 1 to April 1', put in the note, not in season.

Other rules: boating 5 mph, small trolling motors only (SSR 06.01D); no hunting (06.02D); archery range closed to camping (06.02E); horseback riding allowed on roads; RC airplane field. Phone 402-364-2145 is the NRD office (Davenport).
